document_withdrawn.name: document_withdrawn
document_withdrawn.value:
("documents"."withdrawn_at" IS NULL AND "documents"."withdrawn_by" IS NULL AND "documents"."withdrawn_reason" IS NULL)
        OR ("documents"."withdrawn_at" IS NOT NULL AND "documents"."withdrawn_by" IS NOT NULL AND char_length(btrim("documents"."withdrawn_reason")) BETWEEN 3 AND 500 AND "documents"."state" = 'archived')

engagement_period.name: engagement_period
engagement_period.value: "engagements"."ends_on" IS NULL OR "engagements"."starts_on" IS NULL OR "engagements"."ends_on" >= "engagements"."starts_on"

evidence_submissions_received.name: evidence_submissions_received
evidence_submissions_received.value: ("evidence_submissions"."source" = 'consultant_recorded') = ("evidence_submissions"."received_via" IS NOT NULL AND "evidence_submissions"."received_on" IS NOT NULL)

evidence_submissions_received_only.name: evidence_submissions_received_only
evidence_submissions_received_only.value: "evidence_submissions"."source" = 'consultant_recorded' OR ("evidence_submissions"."received_via" IS NULL AND "evidence_submissions"."received_on" IS NULL)

inquiry_contact_kept.name: inquiry_contact_kept
inquiry_contact_kept.value: "inquiries"."anonymised_at" IS NOT NULL OR ("inquiries"."org_name" IS NOT NULL AND ("inquiries"."source" <> 'website' OR ("inquiries"."contact_email" IS NOT NULL AND "inquiries"."contact_name" IS NOT NULL)))

inquiry_website_fields.name: inquiry_website_fields
inquiry_website_fields.value: "inquiries"."source" <> 'website' OR ("inquiries"."privacy_notice_version" IS NOT NULL AND "inquiries"."consented_at" IS NOT NULL AND "inquiries"."entered_by" IS NULL)

inquiry_contact_channel.name: inquiry_contact_channel
inquiry_contact_channel.value: "inquiries"."contact_channel" = 'email' OR "inquiries"."contact_phone" IS NOT NULL OR "inquiries"."anonymised_at" IS NOT NULL

inquiry_family_fields.name: inquiry_family_fields
inquiry_family_fields.value: coalesce("inquiries"."ownership_type" IN ('family_single_owner', 'family_multi_partner'), false) OR ("inquiries"."family_generation" IS NULL AND "inquiries"."family_working" IS NULL AND "inquiries"."family_governance" IS NULL)

inquiry_tender_fields.name: inquiry_tender_fields
inquiry_tender_fields.value: CASE WHEN "inquiries"."source" = 'tender' THEN "inquiries"."tender_number" IS NOT NULL AND "inquiries"."tender_number" ~ '^[0-9A-Za-z-]{1,40}$' ELSE "inquiries"."tender_number" IS NULL AND "inquiries"."tender_closes_on" IS NULL END

inquiry_source_client.name: inquiry_source_client
inquiry_source_client.value: CASE "inquiries"."source" WHEN 'existing_client' THEN "inquiries"."source_client_org_id" IS NOT NULL WHEN 'referral' THEN true ELSE "inquiries"."source_client_org_id" IS NULL END

inquiry_qualification_range.name: inquiry_qualification_range
inquiry_qualification_range.value: "inquiry_qualifications"."fit" BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND "inquiry_qualifications"."need" BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND "inquiry_qualifications"."authority" BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND "inquiry_qualifications"."urgency" BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND "inquiry_qualifications"."budget" BETWEEN 1 AND 3

progress_updates_received.name: progress_updates_received
progress_updates_received.value: ("progress_updates"."source" = 'consultant_recorded') = ("progress_updates"."received_via" IS NOT NULL AND "progress_updates"."received_on" IS NOT NULL)

progress_updates_received_only.name: progress_updates_received_only
progress_updates_received_only.value: "progress_updates"."source" = 'consultant_recorded' OR ("progress_updates"."received_via" IS NULL AND "progress_updates"."received_on" IS NULL)

closure_item_one_sustainer.name: closure_item_one_sustainer
closure_item_one_sustainer.value: sustainer_user_id IS NULL OR sustainer_contact_id IS NULL

closure_item_sustainer_handover.name: closure_item_sustainer_handover
closure_item_sustainer_handover.value: disposition = 'handed_over' OR (sustainer_user_id IS NULL AND sustainer_contact_id IS NULL)

project_closures_one_open.name: project_closures_one_open
project_closures_one_open.where: cancelled_at IS NULL AND reopened_at IS NULL

template_questions_sourced.name: template_questions_sourced
template_questions_sourced.value:
("template_questions"."basis" <> 'good_practice' AND coalesce(cardinality("template_questions"."legal_for"), 0) = 0 AND coalesce(cardinality("template_questions"."guidance_for"), 0) = 0)
        OR (nullif(trim("template_questions"."citation"), '') IS NOT NULL AND nullif(trim("template_questions"."locator"), '') IS NOT NULL)

template_questions_applies.name: template_questions_applies
template_questions_applies.value: ("template_questions"."applies_if_question_id" IS NULL) = ("template_questions"."applies_if_values" IS NULL) AND ("template_questions"."applies_if_values" IS NULL OR cardinality("template_questions"."applies_if_values") > 0)
